author: Leila Gharani
description:
Stop trying to remember everything you accomplished this year from scratch. Use this Microsoft 365 Copilot prompt to pull your wins together for your performance review:

Prompt:
Look across my Outlook, Teams, Calendar, OneDrive, and SharePoint activity for 2026 and create a brag doc of my most meaningful accomplishments. Focus on outcomes, impact, collaboration, influence, delivery, and growth rather than simply listing activity. Combine related evidence into accomplishments and remove duplicates. For each item include the period, theme/project, accomplishment, impact, collaborators, and supporting source. Do not infer or fabricate results that aren't supported by my Microsoft 365 activity. Write it confidently but factually for a performance or promotion conversation, and create the result as "Brag Doc.docx"
